blocks.content: Quiz: What happens to session storage data when the browser tab is closed?
Tap an option below to answer:
Session storage is designed to be temporary and does not survive browser restarts or tab closures.
Session storage is designed to be temporary and does not survive browser restarts or tab closures.
It is deleted when the tab is closed.
Session storage is specific to a single browser tab and is cleared when the tab is closed.
Session storage is specific to a single browser tab and is cleared when the tab is closed.
It is shared across all tabs.
Session storage is not shared across tabs.
Session storage is not shared across tabs.
It is stored permanently unless explicitly cleared.
Permanent storage is a characteristic of local storage, not session storage.
Permanent storage is a characteristic of local storage, not session storage.
